contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #340: Counterexample to Arnold's Nearby Lagrangian Conjecture

Exact staged September 23, 2026 manuscript assertions and the bounded zero-band audit. Recording a manuscript assertion is not certifying it. The bounded audit concerns the normalized S^9 family obtained under Proposition one-critical.

definitions.Tkl: The C^1 path component of q|S^{k+l-1} among angular functions having 0 as a regular value.
definitions.stable_tubes: The based telescope of T_{m,m} under addition of q_{1,1}; unequal positive/negative additions enter this telescope by cofinality.
definitions.gamma: Stable spherical fibration of the negative domains D(h)={h<=0}; gamma:T->BG.
definitions.H: Smooth h-cobordism space with identified incoming manifold, collared product vertical boundary, and unparametrized outgoing boundary.
definitions.Hs: The interval-product stabilization telescope of H.
definitions.normalized_family: Smooth f:S^9 x R^{k+l}->R; only critical point 0; f=q_{k,l} near 0; smooth degree-two homogeneous at infinity; k,l>=20 and l>k+9 after stabilization.
definitions.annulus: Y x [0,1], Y=S^{k+l-1}, radius r(t)>0 with r'(t)>0; f=r^2 s, and s is t-independent on both end collars.
definitions.Sigma: {q=0} intersect Y, identified with S^{k-1} x S^{l-1}.
definitions.C: C_b={s_b=0}; incoming boundary identified with the fixed Sigma.
definitions.band: R_b={|s_b|<=epsilon}, with a family diffeomorphism C_b x J->R_b preserving s_b as the J coordinate and the fixed incoming collar.
definitions.W: (Y x [-1,0]) union R_b, with incoming Y x {-1}, inside Y x [-1,2].
definitions.sigma_faces: C^- x J has incoming X x {-1} x J, fixed vertical X x [-1,0] x boundary J, and outgoing (N x J) union (C x boundary J), followed by compatible bending.
definitions.extension: For codimension-zero e:X->Y, glue the h-cobordism to the trivial complement cylinder, equivalently replace the incoming collar by Y x I.
definitions.Morse_family: 0 is a regular value of the full vertical-gradient map d_wF, not necessarily of its restriction to each fiber.

contexts.statement: Parametric zero-band theorem for a compact smooth base B of dimension d. All products, extensions and family isomorphisms are relative to the fixed incoming collars; the outgoing bundle need not be trivial in advance.

definitions.B: An arbitrary compact smooth parameter manifold, of dimension d.
definitions.annular_data: Y closed, s smooth on B x Y x [0,1], constant in t on end collars, fixed regular h0 at the incoming end, regular h1_b at the outgoing end; r>0 and rprime>0; F=r^2 s has nowhere-zero vertical differential.
definitions.normalized_f: Smooth f on B x R^{k+l}, only critical point 0, fixed q_{k,l} near 0, exactly smooth homogeneous at infinity of type T_{k,l}, with k,l>=3.
definitions.C_and_W: C={s=0}; the band R={|s|<=epsilon}; W=(Y x [-1,0]) union R inside Y x [-1,2].
definitions.H: Lower interval-product smooth h-cobordism model, with the incoming manifold and collars fixed and outgoing end unparametrized.

contexts.statement: The full one-critical obstruction for S^9, with variable homogeneous infinity data and no chosen normal framing. Only the normalized zero-band deduction has prior independent approval.

definitions.hypotheses: B=S^9; p>=20; smooth f_b on R^(2p), degree-two homogeneous outside one uniform ball with angular data in T_(p,p); one smooth nondegenerate critical section; stable spherical infinity class null.
definitions.stabilization: Add ten positive squares, smooth outside a large ball, so k=p and l=p+10; add ten negative squares after proving finite-stage tube nullity.
definitions.core_dimensions: m=k-1; N=k+l-1; q=dim(S^9 x I)=10. Only same-parameter double points are forbidden.
definitions.evidence_boundary: The prose proof carries the topological argument; the exact verifier covers differential identities, error budgets and dimension inequalities, not J theory, transversality or bundle equivalence.

contexts.statement: Existence audit for the manuscript balanced stable tube model and its closed exact embedded realization. The accepted full one-critical obstruction is reused as a separate campaign fact, not an input to this construction.

definitions.tube_model: T_(k,l) is the C1 path component of the split quadratic angular function with zero a regular value; stabilization adds one negative and one positive square.
definitions.gamma: Stable spherical fibration of the negative domains, not the gradient normal invariant.
definitions.connecting_map: The actual boundary homomorphism in the stable tube fibration is unknown; universal finite-group deductions do not compute it.
definitions.construction: For a localized homogeneous family g_b on R^N, F(b,v,w)=G_b(w)-R(b) beta(|w|/T) dot(v,w), with R=Lambda exp(K theta).
definitions.evidence_boundary: The prose proof uses cited topology. The exact script checks universal finite-group arithmetic, analytic identities and adversarial local models, not the imported homotopy equivalences or an explicit representative of a.

contexts.statement: Direct Hamiltonian transport of the accepted embedded realization, retaining the actual varying homogeneous infinity class on a fixed S^9 slice. The previously independently reviewed realization, one-critical obstruction and quantitative smoothing lemma are internal inputs, not recomputed results. No AIS or general isotopy-invariance theorem is assumed.

definitions.Morse_family: The full vertical-gradient map is transverse to zero; its fiber Hessians may be singular before the zero-section endpoint.
definitions.support: All Hamiltonians have one compact support inside T*U, where U is the product-of-spheres Euclidean cylinder with compact closure.
definitions.infinity: Smooth degree-two homogeneous data outside one uniform ball, classified in the existing C1 regular-angular balanced tube telescope.
definitions.fixed_slice: b maps to ((b,v0),alpha=0); its embedding is not moved during transport.
definitions.evidence_boundary: Exact symbolic identities and adversarial local models support a prose proof. They do not formalize smooth topology or certify novelty.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 340 ('A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture', unformalized in Lean), which claims to construct a closed exact smoothly embedded Lagrangian in T*(S^9 x S^(N-1)) diffeomorphic to the base but not Hamiltonian isotopic to the zero section: specifically audit all sign, orientation, Maslov/Morse index, and Eliashberg-Murphy / tube-surgery conventions in sections/tubes.tex, sections/morse.tex, sections/obstruction.tex, sections/embedding.tex, and sections/transport.tex, and either (a) certify a rigorous refutation/gap (such as a sign or orientation error analogous to the retracted split abelian eightfolds manuscript), or (b) independently certify the exact obstruction and surgery calculations.
For some sufficiently large even N, Q=S^9 x S^{N-1} admits a closed exact embedded Lagrangian diffeomorphic to Q but not compactly supported Hamiltonian isotopic to the zero section.
The specified stable smooth tube space fits into Hs(*)->T->BG, and its rigid quadratic map BO->T composes with gamma to BJ.
There is nonzero a in pi_9(T) with gamma_*(a)=0, and BJ_*:pi_9(BO)->pi_9(BG) is injective.

The kernel class has smooth finite-stage representatives, for arbitrarily large m>=20, standard near the two height critical points of S^9, with uniform linear vertical gradient bounds and a linear mixed-derivative bound.

For B=S^9 and p>=20, a smooth family on R^{2p} homogeneous at infinity of type T_{p,p}, with exactly one smoothly varying nondegenerate critical point and trivial stable spherical infinity class, has trivial stable tube infinity class.
For k,l>=3, a one-critical normalized family with infinity data of type T_{k,l} has Morse index k; its negative eigensphere bundle is fiber homotopy equivalent to its negative infinity domains.

Under the hypotheses of one-critical, compactly supported modifications and a logarithmic radial insertion make the unique critical point 0 and its local form the fixed q_{p,p}, without changing infinity data or adding critical points.

A smooth F at uniformly bounded C^1 vertical distance from g(w)+q'(z), where the homogeneous g has a linear positive gradient lower bound, can be made smooth homogeneous outside a larger ball without changing critical points or the regular homogeneous homotopy class.

For the normalized annular family and sufficiently small uniform epsilon, the sign regions admit smooth parameter-dependent fields with +/-df(V)>0, dt(V)>0 near the ends, and +/-ds(V)>0 on their band side, with a common whole-sphere end prescription.

The negative flow embeds the fixed incoming truncated negative tube by a homotopy equivalence into the outgoing one; the complement is the zero-level family C, a smooth family of h-cobordisms with fixed incoming Sigma.
The entire family W, including its fixed incoming collar and transition maps, represents e_!(sigma(C)) for the single interval product stabilization specified in obstruction.tex.

The complement of W in Y x [-1,2], with compatible corner rounding, is smoothly over the full parameter space a cylinder on the varying outgoing boundary E; hence W is an incoming-relative product family.
For k,l>=20 and a collar e:Sigma x J->S^{k+l-1}, the composite H(Sigma)->H(Sigma x J)->H(Y)->Hs(Y) is an isomorphism on pi_9 in the product component and detects null free sphere families.
If C is incoming-relatively trivial and l>k+9, shrinking its collar and disk fibers, normal linearization, and relative parametric general position deform the negative tube family to a fixed tube.
A Morse family defines an exact Lagrangian immersion of its critical locus by (q,w)->(q,d_qF), with primitive the restricted F.

The localized kernel family is realized by a smooth Morse family on (S^9 x S^{N-1}) x R^N, unchanged at infinity, whose generating map is an embedding of a critical locus diffeomorphic to S^9 x S^{N-1}.

A hypothetical Hamiltonian isotopy from the zero section to L has a compactly supported reverse extension in the Euclidean cotangent cylinder, fixing radial positions along its L-cylinder and ending at the zero section on a central slab.

A sufficiently C^1-small compactly supported Hamiltonian increment has global mixed coordinates (X,p) and a compactly supported generator sigma with x=X+sigma_p, P=p+sigma_X, invertible I+sigma_pX, and uniformly controlled spatial support.

Each sufficiently small transport step preserves the generated critical-locus parametrization, regularity and controlled homogeneous infinity data, adding a fixed split quadratic stabilization and a regular homogeneous homotopy.
A regular generating family whose critical-locus projection to the zero-section base is a diffeomorphism has exactly one smoothly varying critical point per base and invertible vertical Hessian.
The manuscript's bent-collar interval product and codimension-zero extension agree, on families and transition maps, with the operations in the cited WJR and CP sources.
For the specified product stabilization, H(X)->Hs(X) is r-connected when dim X>=max(2r+8,3r+5), and a d-connected map induces a (d-1)-connected stable h-cobordism map.

Under the normalized hypotheses actually obtained from one-critical, W represents e_!(sigma(c_B)), is an incoming-relative product family, and injectivity implies c_B=0 as a free S^9-family in H(Sigma).

external_assumptions.statement: The stable smooth h-cobordism space H^s(X) is equivalent to Omega Wh^Diff(X), where the Whitehead space is the infinite-loop space of the cofiber of Sigma^infty X_+ -> A(X). At a point this gives pi_9 H^s(*)=pi_10 Wh^Diff(*).
external_assumptions.source: Waldhausen-Jahren-Rognes, author-hosted prepublication text retained as research/zero_band_audit/wjr2013.pdf and wjr2013-opening.txt, Theorems 0.1 and 0.3. The inspected PDF has 2012 metadata; the final 2013 edition has not been separately obtained.

external_assumptions.statement: The stable ninth stem is (Z/2)^3: the degree-nine row has 2-primary v1-torsion Z/2, no odd-primary v1-torsion, and v1-periodic part (Z/2)^2, which the text specifies as direct-sum constituents.

claims.natural_statement: For the spatially buffered shift F_o(X+k z,w)+sigma(X,p)-z.p with k=zeta_1(X) beta(z) chi(w), every cutoff derivative has the stated chain-rule form. Choosing chi logarithmically excludes outer critical points without further time-step smallness. The full critical equation is regular, including at singular old fiber Hessians and throughout the spatial cutoff transition, and its critical locus parametrizes exactly the transported Lagrangian.

The shifted family differs from g_o(X,w)-z.p by uniformly bounded value and full-vertical first derivative, with explicit constants retaining the differentiated beta and chi terms. The accepted smoothing lemma therefore preserves the complete critical germ and restores smooth homogeneous infinity. The fixed path q_t=-t|z|^2+t|p|^2-(1-t)z.p has signature (d,d) and squared gradient margin at least 4/5. Its regular direct-sum homotopy preserves the actual stable tube class. Evolving family constants never require refinement of the Hamiltonian-fixed finite subdivision.

If the Lagrangian of accepted TR-existence were compactly supported Hamiltonian isotopic to the zero section, direct transport would produce on every fixed S^9 x {v0} slice a smooth family on R^(2p), p>=20, with exactly one smooth nondegenerate critical section, uniform smooth homogeneous T_(p,p) infinity data, and the same nonzero spherically trivial free stable tube class as the original family.

The standalone transport certificate replays the Hamiltonian/action/mixed-generator signs, complete cutoff derivatives, full-regularity block product, uniform-error and logarithmic-margin algebra, fixed split path and adversarial local models. The Jacobian operation checks a symbolic scalar-jet block product with arbitrary fiber Hessian. These are exact algebraic results, not formal verification of global smooth topology, the accepted topological inputs, or novelty.

routes.retired_because: Knowing that each individual h-cobordism is a product only places the classifying map in a product component BP(Sigma); it does not nullhomotope that map. The active route instead constructs a product complement over the entire parameter space.

The upstream J_8 normalization needs the explicitly stated varying-Q_b comparison in v3. Replaced by a current-version route; this is a scope clarification, not a mathematical refutation.
